place.summary: Wan Chai functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TH. It receives notable inbound connections from Central. Visitors often continue to Central.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Central
opportunity_cards.detail: Wan Chai frequently appears alongside Central, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Sunny Bay Station
opportunity_cards.detail: Visitors often continue from Wan Chai to Sunny Bay Station, with relatively strong journey experience.
